description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DecryptionTraitV2' within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods for decrypting data using various cipher algorithms and handling encryption metadata. It includes abstract dependencies for obtaining cipher methods and encryption keys, and concrete implementations for decryption stream creation and validation.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of ciphertext using the provided materials provider, metadata envelope, and options, returning a decryption stream.

methods.name: getTagFromCiphertextStream
methods.description: Extracts the authentication tag from the ciphertext stream based on specified tag length.

methods.name: getStrippedCiphertextStream
methods.description: Returns a stream of ciphertext with the tag removed, ready for decryption.

methods.name: validateOptionsAndEnvelope
methods.description: Validates decryption options and metadata envelope, ensuring supported cipher and key wrap algorithms and matching encryption schemes.

methods.name: getDecryptingStream
methods.description: Creates a decryption stream based on the cipher type, wrapping the ciphertext stream with proper cipher class and applying decryption key.
